messages:
jas: heads-up: telemetry bill spike — routing-policy sampling is at 100% for newly onboarded tenants. need to reduce noise without losing debugging signal
maria: link to cost graph?
jas: https://console.internal/infra/billing#month spike on 2026-03-20, mostly `route.resolve` and per-token trace events
henry: i think this came from that opt-in debug flag we enabled for SDKs last quarter. some clients defaulted it on in nightly builds
lin: which SDKs? python/ts/go?
henry: mainly TS nightly and an internal go shim used by a few large customers. python was fine
maria: ops-proposal:
1) server-side: change default sampling to 2% for routing-policy telemetry, keep full sampling for errors
2) SDKs: add explicit header `X-Rdw-Telemetry: full|sampled|off` so customers can opt into full traces; default to `sampled` in released builds
3) console: add a toggle per-tenant to temporarily lift sampling for a diagnostic window (1h) and tag samples with `telemetry_migration=2026-03`
henry: +1. SDK owners should push a patch that sets header to `sampled` and exposes opt-in flag in config (env var + client option)
jas: can we do the server change as a canary first? reduce sample rate to 2% for non-error, bump error traces to 100%, and watch cost and debugging impact
lin: i'll implement the server-side canary in the ingest proxy. canary 5% at 11:30 PT. will add metric `trace_sampling.variant` so we can measure traces per-token by tenant
ci-bot: deploy queued: ingest-sampling-shim-canary -> 2026-03-22 11:30 PT, 5% traffic, id: cb-49899-samp
maria: SDK tasks: TS owner (henry) and Go owner (lin) to release patches. include tests that assert header presence and that config environment variables override defaults
henry: TS PR opened: ts#501. exposes client config `telemetryMode` enum, default 'sampled'. docs + migration notes included. will add a small runtime WARN if nightly detections enable full mode
lin: go PR open: go#210. same API surface. i'll coordinate with the internal shim teams that flip env for their builds
jas: console: add the per-tenant diagnostic toggle and a chart showing sampled vs full traces over time. add an alert if error trace rate drops after change
maria: on it. ETA 45m for dash changes. also adding `telemetry_mode` tag to inbound traces so we can filter by client header
henry: quick note: some batch clients send mixed telemetryMode per item when aggregating. shim should honor the most permissive (full if any child requests full)
lin: noted, will implement permissive merge in the proxy shim. tests will include mixed-batch cases
ci-bot: canary started at 11:30 PT. monitoring 5% traffic now
jas: watching cost and `route.resolve` trace count
maria: early signal: non-error trace volume down ~88% for canary traffic. error traces unaffected
henry: good. once canary stable we'll roll to 50% and cut SDK releases. importance: update release notes and add short how-to in #devex so customers know how to opt-in for troubleshooting
jas: agreed. thanks team — ping this thread when SDK releases are published and when console toggle is live
maria: console toggle live. SDK releases drafted. closing loop soon.
